item.title: BigAsp2-X-SimOmega vpred
item.description:
A refitted and finetuned version of BigAsp2; repaired and refitted to VPRED for utilization.

Atop of the refit the V1 merge is;

50/50 OmegaV0001 clips and BigAsp Clips

Finetune trained with;

  • Stage 1-> 80,000 samples, middle timesteps trained

    • OmegaAsp CLIP_L_1 = BigAsp CLIP_L 50/50 OmegaSim CLIP_L

      • Frozen

    • BigAsp CLIP_G

      • Frozen

  • Stage 2 -> 200,000...??? samples, i lost track honestly

    • OmegaAsp CLIP_L_2 = OmegaAsp_CLIP_L_1 -> BigAsp CLIP_L 50/50 (75% BigAsp now)

      • Frozen

    • BigAsp CLIP_G

      • Frozen

Refitted with frozen clips using the Sim Omega 73 clip_l and clip_g.

This both introduced many safe elements that otherwise don't work in BigAsp, as well as destroyed many of the NSFW elements that completely ruined generations during the conversion.

The 3 versions are intended to be for those who enjoy the original or the new more.

item.title: Perspective View Enhancer for low or high angles F1D
item.description:
Increases the perspective of your image, giving it more depth.

The examples will give you an idea of the effect.

anm-prspct is the trigger. You can choose between

  1. low angle - shot from ground with perspective

  2. high angle - shot from above with perspective

  3. straight view - shot with a straight perspective

I used buckets for this LoRA to optimize portrait/landscape output as well as square.

Effects are rather strong, reduce strength to have more subtle effects.

Any feedback is appreciated!!!

item.title: ZH LoRA | Ellen Barkin 80s (retro tribute) | American actress
item.description:
Countdown to Goodbye! (please read): https://civitai.com/articles/12655

Actress series: Ellen Rona Barkin. Trained on a large dataset (220 images). Sample images generated WITHOUT any other LoRAs (except my own) as a demonstration of this LoRA's capabilities.

Made this as there isn't a LoRA of her on here yet, and to try something a little different. Curated from lower quality images from the 1980s. Pair with my 80s fashion style lora for added effect.

Check out my checkpoint merges here: Aneurysm (realism-newly updated with v2), Acoustica (semi-real) and Anabolic (modern anime). Download my other LoRAs here

Thank you for 1.3K followers! Your comments/reviews/likes/follows are most welcome. I'd love to see the images you create, so please share on here or reach me on Discord (zombiehead91). Feel free to message me on CivitAI's messaging feature too.

About the subject:

American actress (born April 16, 1954) who gained popularity in the 1980s due to her natural blonde good looks, starting with her breakthrough role in the 1982 film Diner. She subsequently became a leading actress with starring roles in films like Tender Mercies (1983), Eddie and the Cruisers (1983), The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai Across the 8th Dimension (1984), The Big Easy (1986), Johnny Handsome, and Sea of Love (both 1989).

Her career continued in later years as well, with notable films including This Boy's Life (1993), Bad Company, Wild Bill (both 1995), The Fan (1996), Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas (1998), Drop Dead Gorgeous (1999), Crime and Punishment in Suburbia (2000), Ocean's Thirteen (2007), Brooklyn's Finest (2009), and The Cobbler (2014). She also played the leading role of Janine "Smurf" Cody on the drama series Animal Kingdom (2016-2019).

She achieved great critical success as well, with a Golden Globe nomination for Best Actress for her leading role in the film Switch (1991), a Primetime Emmy Award for the television film Before Women Had Wings (1998), and a Tony Award for her Broadway theatre debut in The Normal Heart (2011).

Trigger word: ZH_Ell3nBark1n

Other useful triggers: 1girl, solo, realistic, looking at viewer, brown eyes, blonde hair, long hair, short hair (see tags in LoRA for full list).

Suggested settings

ADetailer, hi-res.fix use is recommended.
Suggested settings : 0.8 to 1, Clip Skip: 1-2, ADetailer recommended
Method: DPM++(3M or 2M) SDE Karras, Steps:30-50, CFG : 6-7, 512x768 + high res fix with 2x upscale

Notice : Usage of this resource is ONLY permitted for educational, personal and non-commercial use. Please observe the permissions listed on this page - do NOT share this resource anywhere else without my knowledge, especially on other sites for commercial use. Please be respectful of the subject and CivitAI terms of use, and avoid all NSFW content. No warranty is provided, and the user bears responsibility for any/all use of this resource. Happy to discuss this further on Discord if unclear

About the training data:

This LoRA was trained on 220 images of the subject
